feature_contract.goal: Keep real OutRun menu, vehicle selection and race full-size native DX11 game frames contiguous when successful original D3D9 ColorFill rectangles cross physical backbuffer edges, with correct ordered pre-Draw seed, live post-Draw ClearView and original input/render fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Real successful original D3D9 ColorFill is clipped to exact canonical backbuffer before bounded ordered pre-Draw native RTV tiles; fully outside writes create no tiles.
A partially overlapping ColorFill uses clipped D3D11.1 ClearView; full-surface clip chooses whole native RTV Clear while preserving game Draw order and current-Present output.
Unknown/malformed rectangles, foreign backbuffer or failed owner checks do not permit native writes; original D3D9 HRESULT/render/input/FFB and frozen DXVK remain untouched.
Changed-source C++ positive/negative regression and the five mandatory GitHub Actions gates must succeed on one exact validation-bearing commit; Quest3/VDXR visual test remains separate.

integration_path: Original game D3D9 Clear and ColorFill hooks establish device-owned full-size backbuffer and ordered ColorFill rect provenance
Clip successful pre-Draw game tile rectangles against exact backbuffer; replay them as D3D11.1 ClearView before real game Draw/DrawIndexed
Clip post-Draw ColorFill with original D3D9 HRESULT and canonical RT ownership; preserve native color target through live D3D11 Draw and D3D9 same-Present publication
Reject invalid owner, malformed extents, unsupported D3D11.1 and other unmirrored paths while preserving original DX9Ex/gamepad/FFB
batch_components: C++ game-native ColorFill clipping and pre-Draw source tile queue in native_game_source_mutation.hpp
C++ live game bridge pre-Draw and post-Draw native D3D11.1 RTV ClearView/whole RT presentation
Portable C++ functional/negative tests plus existing pre-Draw native frame batch regression and DX11 Fast registration

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: Portable constexpr native ColorFill source tile tests cover left/right/top/bottom clipping, whole-backbuffer normalized fill, queue order, real native Draw ClearView source path.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Foreign producer identity, reversed/empty source rect, missing canonical surface, unsafe resource dimensions, capacity overflow and unsupported D3D11.1 leave original D3D9 path authoritative.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: D3D9 successful ColorFill hook -> canonical backbuffer clipped tile queue -> D3D11 native live Draw/Indexed RTV ClearView -> same-Present full-size output -> original D3D9 input fallback.
